 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Divide at full separator rows/columns. Each cell in the result marks a tile
    # containing multiple occurrences of the foreground color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    sep = next((v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != bg and any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)), None)
    if sep is None:
        return []
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        result_row=[]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0,c1=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            n=sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            result_row.append(1 if n > 1 else bg)
        out.append(result_row)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
